decision_conditions: <p>By reason of the intensification of the site and the number of people proposed to be on site, the proposal would result in an unreasonable degree of impacts with regard to noise and disturbance to the detriment of the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to Policies D3, D13 and D14 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy DM46 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>By reasons of the over intensification of the site and the number of people proposed to be on site, the proposal would result in an unreasonable degree of impacts with regard to traffic and parking impacts; and that the applicant has failed to demonstrate that adequate provision has been made for waste, servicing and deliveries. The development is thereby contrary to Policy T4.F and T7.G of The London Plan (2021) and Policies DM42.F, DM43.C, DM44 and DM45 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>By reasons of the loss of the residential floorspace without reprovision and the failure to demonstrate an identified need for the proposed facility and that the proposal would be located within the community that it is intended to serve, the proposed change of use would result in an inappropriate over intensification of the site which would fail to comply with Policies H8.A and S3.B of the London Plan (2021) and Policy DM46.B of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>
description: Change of use from residential (Class C3) to Day Nursery (Class E)
